name: 12807-longprefill-dsv2lite-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, bf16, 15.7B total / ~2.4B activated, 27 layers, MoE (64 routed + 2 shared experts); full geometry is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bound 320 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn synthetic text, no shared prefix; prompt exactly 8192 tokens and output exactly 128 tokens, min=max on both, temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos so neither length can vary.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on one GPU, summarizing 8K-token inputs into short answers for 64 concurrent users.
launch:
# The engine's command line: vLLM 0.7.2, commit cefd56ee354b915e2fff6b2b5eb1f8b55721fe7e.
# Flat reader: every key must be top-level and every value must fit on one line.
# This era's argument parser raises on an unknown key, so do not add a field from a later vLLM.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
trust-remote-code: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 10240
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 128
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
